---
title: "Sign Up / Login"
---

To sign up for GitHub, visit the [website](https://github.com/) and create an account. If you already have an account, you can log in and enter your credentials.

GitHub requires two-factor authentication on accounts that contribute code and strongly recommends it for every account, so expect to be asked to set it up. You set it up with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy and others) or text messages, and can then add a passkey or a security key.

Prefer an authenticator app over text messages: SMS can be intercepted by porting your phone number, and GitHub itself recommends against it. Save the recovery codes it gives you somewhere you can reach without your phone — they are the only way back into the account if you lose the device.
